comment: Images 3D façon film d'animation des objets de la boutique. Lues par tools/make-item-art.ps1 (création) et tools/make_item_art.py (détourage). style = prop (objet), creature (animal, personnage) ou scenery (décor plein cadre). key = couleur du fond à retirer : green, magenta pour les objets qui ont du vert, none pour les décors.

styles.prop: Pixar-style 3D animated feature film prop render, like the toys and vehicles of Toy Story or Cars and the objects of Coco: stylized appealing chunky toy-like shapes with soft rounded bevelled edges, rich saturated colors, soft physically based materials (glossy painted metal, soft plastic, rubber, polished wood, leather, velvet), warm soft key light with a subtle rim light, soft ambient occlusion, cinematic high-detail render.
styles.creature: Pixar-style 3D animated feature film character render, like the animals of Zootopia, Coco or Ratatouille: stylized appealing chubby proportions, big expressive eyes with glossy irises and bright catchlights, soft rounded shapes, soft fur or skin with subsurface scattering, warm soft key light with a subtle rim light, cinematic high-detail render.
styles.scenery: Pixar-style 3D animated feature film set, like the cozy sets of Toy Story, Up, Cars or Coco: stylized toy-like chunky rounded shapes, soft warm and slightly pastel colors, friendly and cozy for young children, gentle soft lighting, soft depth of field; not realistic, not futuristic, not sci-fi, not dark. A completely empty set: absolutely no people, no children, no characters, no animals, no robots, no vehicles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs and no logo unless the description explicitly asks for one. Tall portrait composition; the bottom quarter of the image is a wide, flat, completely empty floor or ground with nothing standing on it, seen slightly from above and kept completely empty, and the middle of the image stays open and uncluttered.

cutout.green: A single object shown whole, entirely inside the image with a comfortable margin on every side, never cropped. Perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-key green background (#00FF00) with no gradient, no floor, no cast shadow, no reflection, no scenery and no green light on the object. The object itself has no green at all. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.
cutout.magenta: A single object shown whole, entirely inside the image with a comfortable margin on every side, never cropped. Perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-key magenta background (#FF00FF) with no gradient, no floor, no cast shadow, no reflection, no scenery and no magenta light on the object. The object itself has no magenta and no pink at all. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.
